title_zh: 一个应用，两种实用结果
caption_en: Gear Room changes its useful message when Portable or Desk setup is selected and its button is tapped.
caption_zh: 选择 Portable 或 Desk setup 并点击按钮，Gear Room 会显示相应的实用信息。
alt_en: Gear Room changes its useful message when Portable or Desk setup is selected and its button is tapped.
alt_zh: 选择 Portable 或 Desk setup 并点击按钮，Gear Room 会显示相应的实用信息。
source: Original classroom illustration using supplied project content

caption_en: Fashion, gaming and photography examples are possibilities; the fourth card invites an appropriate original topic.
caption_zh: 穿搭、游戏装备和摄影只是例子；第四张卡鼓励选择自己的合适主题。
alt_en: Fashion, gaming and photography examples are possibilities; the fourth card invites an appropriate original topic.
alt_zh: 穿搭、游戏装备和摄影只是例子；第四张卡鼓励选择自己的合适主题。
source: Original classroom illustration using supplied project content

caption_en: The chosen value is read when the Click event starts the condition; the matching message is displayed.
caption_zh: Click 事件触发后，程序读取所选的值、检查条件，再显示相应信息。
alt_en: The chosen value is read when the Click event starts the condition; the matching message is displayed.
alt_zh: Click 事件触发后，程序读取所选的值、检查条件，再显示相应信息。
source: Original classroom illustration using supplied project content

caption_en: Quick summary matches the condition and follows THEN. More detail does not match and follows ELSE. Both are intended results.
caption_zh: Quick summary 满足条件，执行 THEN；More detail 不满足条件，执行 ELSE。两种结果都符合设计。
alt_en: Quick summary matches the condition and follows THEN. More detail does not match and follows ELSE. Both are intended results.
alt_zh: Quick summary 满足条件，执行 THEN；More detail 不满足条件，执行 ELSE。两种结果都符合设计。
source: Original classroom illustration using supplied project content

title_zh: 两处使用完全相同的文字
caption_en: Portable is both the first menu choice and the comparison text. Its spelling, capitals and spaces match.
caption_zh: 第一个菜单选项和比较文字都为 Portable；拼写、大小写和空格保持一致。
alt_en: Portable is both the first menu choice and the comparison text. Its spelling, capitals and spaces match.
alt_zh: 第一个菜单选项和比较文字都为 Portable；拼写、大小写和空格保持一致。
source: Original classroom illustration using supplied project content

caption_en: An intentionally labelled mismatch compares Portable with the old Quick summary text. The repaired example compares Portable with Portable.
caption_zh: 明确标注的错误示例把 Portable 与旧文字 Quick summary 比较；修复后，两处都使用 Portable。
alt_en: An intentionally labelled mismatch compares Portable with the old Quick summary text. The repaired example compares Portable with Portable.
alt_zh: 明确标注的错误示例把 Portable 与旧文字 Quick summary 比较；修复后，两处都使用 Portable。
source: Original classroom illustration using supplied project content

caption_en: Designer changes the layout, Blocks changes instructions, and Companion runs the app. The Spinner may show add items... in Designer; this preview does not run the button code.
caption_zh: Designer 修改外观，Blocks 修改指令，Companion 运行应用。Designer 中的下拉框可能显示 add items...；这个预览不会执行按钮代码。
alt_en: Designer changes the layout, Blocks changes instructions, and Companion runs the app. The Spinner may show add items... in Designer; this preview does not run the button code.
alt_zh: Designer 修改外观，Blocks 修改指令，Companion 运行应用。Designer 中的下拉框可能显示 add items...；这个预览不会执行按钮代码。
source: Original classroom illustration using supplied project content

caption_en: The saved project can remain MyChoice_W10 while TitleLabel.Text shows Gear Room. Find the saved project name when reopening.
caption_zh: 保存的项目仍可名为 MyChoice_W10，而 TitleLabel.Text 显示 Gear Room。重新打开时，要找保存的项目名称。
alt_en: The saved project can remain MyChoice_W10 while TitleLabel.Text shows Gear Room. Find the saved project name when reopening.
alt_zh: 保存的项目仍可名为 MyChoice_W10，而 TitleLabel.Text 显示 Gear Room。重新打开时，要找保存的项目名称。
source: Original classroom illustration using supplied project content

title_en: Find the preview, components and properties.
title_zh: 找到外观预览、组件和属性。
caption_en: A is the Designer layout preview, B the component list and C the editable properties. This is not a running Companion app.
caption_zh: A 是 Designer 外观预览，B 是组件列表，C 是可修改的属性。这里不是运行中的 Companion 应用。
alt_en: A is the Designer layout preview, B the component list and C the editable properties. This is not a running Companion app.
alt_zh: A 是 Designer 外观预览，B 是组件列表，C 是可修改的属性。这里不是运行中的 Companion 应用。

title_en: Find the event and the supplied helpers.
title_zh: 找到点击事件和已提供的辅助积木。
caption_en: A is ActionButton.Click and contains the two-response decision. B is the supplied Reset helper. C is the selection-change helper.
caption_zh: A 是 ActionButton.Click，里面有两种回应的判断；B 是已提供的重置事件；C 是选项改变时的辅助事件。
alt_en: A is ActionButton.Click and contains the two-response decision. B is the supplied Reset helper. C is the selection-change helper.
alt_zh: A 是 ActionButton.Click，里面有两种回应的判断；B 是已提供的重置事件；C 是选项改变时的辅助事件。

annotation_key.label_zh: 选项改变时的辅助事件

caption_en: Select TitleLabel and edit its Text property. This changes the visible title without changing the component name.
caption_zh: 选择 TitleLabel，修改 Text 属性。这会改变用户看到的标题，不会改变组件名称。
alt_en: Select TitleLabel and edit its Text property. This changes the visible title without changing the component name.
alt_zh: 选择 TitleLabel，修改 Text 属性。这会改变用户看到的标题，不会改变组件名称。

caption_en: The full starter value is Quick summary,More detail. One English comma separates two choices. The narrow MIT field may show only part of the value.
caption_zh: 完整起始值为 Quick summary,More detail。一个英文逗号分隔两个选项；MIT 的窄输入框可能只显示部分文字。
alt_en: The full starter value is Quick summary,More detail. One English comma separates two choices. The narrow MIT field may show only part of the value.
alt_zh: 完整起始值为 Quick summary,More detail。一个英文逗号分隔两个选项；MIT 的窄输入框可能只显示部分文字。

caption_en: Change ActionButton.Text to describe the information the button will show. Keep its component name ActionButton.
caption_zh: 修改 ActionButton 的 Text，说明按钮会显示什么信息；保留组件名称 ActionButton。
alt_en: Change ActionButton.Text to describe the information the button will show. Keep its component name ActionButton.
alt_zh: 修改 ActionButton 的 Text，说明按钮会显示什么信息；保留组件名称 ActionButton。

title_zh: 点击按钮后，开始进行这个比较。
caption_en: A marks the Click event. B compares ChoiceSpinner.Selection with Quick summary.
caption_zh: A 标出 Click 事件；B 把 ChoiceSpinner.Selection 与 Quick summary 进行比较。
alt_en: A marks the Click event. B compares ChoiceSpinner.Selection with Quick summary.
alt_zh: A 标出 Click 事件；B 把 ChoiceSpinner.Selection 与 Quick summary 进行比较。
source: Genuine handler.png crop from MIT-exported MyChoice_W10, captured 2026-10-26

title_en: The first message is inside THEN.
title_zh: 第一条信息位于 THEN 分支中。
caption_en: Only the pink text is highlighted: Compact camera. Easy to carry. It is the response for the matching first choice.
caption_zh: 只突出粉红色文字：Compact camera. Easy to carry.。它回应与条件一致的第一个选项。
alt_en: Only the pink text is highlighted: Compact camera. Easy to carry. It is the response for the matching first choice.
alt_zh: 只突出粉红色文字：Compact camera. Easy to carry.。它回应与条件一致的第一个选项。
source: Genuine handler.png crop from MIT-exported MyChoice_W10, captured 2026-10-26

title_en: The other message is inside ELSE.
title_zh: 另一条信息位于 ELSE 分支中。
caption_en: The pink ELSE message is Zoom lens and a rechargeable battery. It is used when the selected value does not match Quick summary.
caption_zh: ELSE 中的粉红色信息为 Zoom lens and a rechargeable battery.。所选的值不等于 Quick summary 时，显示这条信息。
alt_en: The pink ELSE message is Zoom lens and a rechargeable battery. It is used when the selected value does not match Quick summary.
alt_zh: ELSE 中的粉红色信息为 Zoom lens and a rechargeable battery.。所选的值不等于 Quick summary 时，显示这条信息。
source: Genuine handler.png crop from MIT-exported MyChoice_W10, captured 2026-10-26

title_zh: 把这三处文字改成你自己的内容。
caption_en: 1 must match the first menu choice; 2 is its useful response; 3 is the other choice’s useful response. Keep the connected block structure.
caption_zh: 1 必须与第一个菜单选项一致；2 是它的实用回应；3 是另一个选项的实用回应。保留现有积木结构。
alt_en: 1 must match the first menu choice; 2 is its useful response; 3 is the other choice’s useful response. Keep the connected block structure.
alt_zh: 1 必须与第一个菜单选项一致；2 是它的实用回应；3 是另一个选项的实用回应。保留现有积木结构。
source: Genuine handler.png crop from MIT-exported MyChoice_W10, captured 2026-10-26

title_en: Same first choice in two places
title_zh: 两处使用相同的第一个选项
caption_en: Two genuine crops show the first starter choice Quick summary in ElementsFromString and in the pink comparison text.
caption_zh: 两处真实截图显示：ElementsFromString 的第一个选项和粉红色比较文字都为 Quick summary。
alt_en: Two genuine crops show the first starter choice Quick summary in ElementsFromString and in the pink comparison text.
alt_zh: 两处真实截图显示：ElementsFromString 的第一个选项和粉红色比较文字都为 Quick summary。
source: Crops from 12-choice-list-visible.png and genuine handler.png; no UI text replaced

caption_en: In Projects, Import project (.aia) from my computer opens the supplied starter. Do not start a blank project for this activity.
caption_zh: 在 Projects 中，Import project (.aia) from my computer 会打开提供的起始项目；本活动不从空白项目开始。
alt_en: In Projects, Import project (.aia) from my computer opens the supplied starter. Do not start a blank project for this activity.
alt_zh: 在 Projects 中，Import project (.aia) from my computer 会打开提供的起始项目；本活动不从空白项目开始。

caption_en: Save project saves the current MIT project; the separate export command downloads its .aia file.
caption_zh: Save project 保存当前 MIT 项目；另一个导出命令才会下载 .aia 文件。
alt_en: Save project saves the current MIT project; the separate export command downloads its .aia file.
alt_zh: Save project 保存当前 MIT 项目；另一个导出命令才会下载 .aia 文件。

title_zh: 导出可编辑的 .aia 项目文件。
caption_en: Export selected project (.aia) to my computer downloads the editable project for backup or Teams submission.
caption_zh: Export selected project (.aia) to my computer 下载可编辑的项目，用于备份或提交到 Teams。
alt_en: Export selected project (.aia) to my computer downloads the editable project for backup or Teams submission.
alt_zh: Export selected project (.aia) to my computer 下载可编辑的项目，用于备份或提交到 Teams。

title_zh: 重新打开同一个已保存的项目。
caption_en: The genuine project-list row shows MyChoice_W10. Select your saved project name to reopen it and check that your changes remain.
caption_zh: 真实项目列表中显示 MyChoice_W10；选择你保存的项目名称，重新打开并检查修改是否保留。
alt_en: The genuine project-list row shows MyChoice_W10. Select your saved project name to reopen it and check that your changes remain.
alt_zh: 真实项目列表中显示 MyChoice_W10；选择你保存的项目名称，重新打开并检查修改是否保留。

caption_en: Use Connect, then AI Companion. Use the fresh code shown by your own project. The screenshot does not supply a reusable code.
caption_zh: 选择 Connect，再选择 AI Companion；使用自己项目刚生成的连接码。截图不提供可重复使用的连接码。
alt_en: Use Connect, then AI Companion. Use the fresh code shown by your own project. The screenshot does not supply a reusable code.
alt_zh: 选择 Connect，再选择 AI Companion；使用自己项目刚生成的连接码。截图不提供可重复使用的连接码。

caption_en: The genuine image picker lists supplied pictures. gaming.png is outlined as an example choice; camera.png is still the selected item in this capture. Select a file and confirm with OK.
caption_zh: 真实图片选择器列出已提供的图片。gaming.png 的边框表示一个示例选项；截图中当前选中的仍是 camera.png。选择所需文件后，点击 OK。
alt_en: The genuine image picker lists supplied pictures. gaming.png is outlined as an example choice; camera.png is still the selected item in this capture. Select a file and confirm with OK.
alt_zh: 真实图片选择器列出已提供的图片。gaming.png 的边框表示一个示例选项；截图中当前选中的仍是 camera.png。选择所需文件后，点击 OK。
source: 09-picture-choices.png, genuine component and picture-picker crops; no UI text replaced

title_zh: 选择已下载的 .aia 项目文件。
caption_en: A opens file selection for MyChoice_W10.aia. After choosing the file, B confirms import. On iPad the file is normally in Files / Downloads.
caption_zh: A 打开文件选择，选择 MyChoice_W10.aia 后，B 确认导入；iPad 上的文件通常位于“文件／下载”。
alt_en: A opens file selection for MyChoice_W10.aia. After choosing the file, B confirms import. On iPad the file is normally in Files / Downloads.
alt_zh: A 打开文件选择，选择 MyChoice_W10.aia 后，B 确认导入；iPad 上的文件通常位于“文件／下载”。

caption_en: Build in the computer browser and run the app in Companion on a school iPad, using the required Wi-Fi connection. No phone is required in school.
caption_zh: 在电脑浏览器制作，在学校 iPad 的 Companion 中运行，并使用所需的 Wi-Fi 连接。在校不需要手机。
alt_en: Build in the computer browser and run the app in Companion on a school iPad, using the required Wi-Fi connection. No phone is required in school.
alt_zh: 在电脑浏览器制作，在学校 iPad 的 Companion 中运行，并使用所需的 Wi-Fi 连接。在校不需要手机。
source: Original classroom illustration using supplied project content

title_zh: 一台 iPad：浏览器与 Companion
caption_en: The same school iPad switches between the browser for building and Companion for running. This is a route diagram, not an iPad screenshot or a completed device trial.
caption_zh: 同一台学校 iPad 在制作所用的浏览器和运行所用的 Companion 之间切换。这是路线示意图，不是 iPad 截图，也不表示已完成设备测试。
alt_en: The same school iPad switches between the browser for building and Companion for running. This is a route diagram, not an iPad screenshot or a completed device trial.
alt_zh: 同一台学校 iPad 在制作所用的浏览器和运行所用的 Companion 之间切换。这是路线示意图，不是 iPad 截图，也不表示已完成设备测试。
source: Original classroom illustration using supplied project content

title_zh: 项目文件的保存与提交
caption_en: Save the MIT project, reopen it to check the changes, export its editable .aia, then attach that file to the practical assignment in Teams.
caption_zh: 先保存 MIT 项目，重新打开检查修改，再导出可编辑的 .aia，并把文件附加到 Teams 实践作业中。
alt_en: Save the MIT project, reopen it to check the changes, export its editable .aia, then attach that file to the practical assignment in Teams.
alt_zh: 先保存 MIT 项目，重新打开检查修改，再导出可编辑的 .aia，并把文件附加到 Teams 实践作业中。
source: Original classroom illustration using supplied project content

caption_en: Illustrated expected behaviour: changing a choice clears the old response; tapping the button shows the matching message. This is not a recording of MIT or an iPad.
caption_zh: 预期行为示意：改变选项后清除旧回应，点击按钮后显示相应信息。这不是 MIT 或 iPad 的实际录屏。
alt_en: An animated Gear Room example follows both choices and their different responses.
alt_zh: Gear Room 动画展示两个选项及其不同回应。
